maddeler.e:
نتناصر (form VI)
# نَتَنَاصَرُ (natanāṣaru) /na.ta.naː.sˤa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
# نَتَنَاصَرَ (natanāṣara) /na.ta.naː.sˤa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
# نَتَنَاصَرْ (natanāṣar) /na.ta.naː.sˤar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاصَرَ (tanāṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
